description: Two checkout-worker pods repeatedly failed startup or readiness in production ca-central-1.
issue_summary: At capture, 2 of 8 desired pods were affected, only 6 were ready, and 11 restarts occurred in the preceding 10 minutes.
trigger_summary: The alert fires on repeated pod startup or readiness failures. This snapshot records 11 restarts and 2 readiness probe failures, but the alert definition does not provide a numeric restart or failure threshold.
startup_summary: Startup reports a missing configuration reference after revision c204. Secret values were not collected.
